Stand up high after dawn and you'll see it. The track's on my phone — just follow it.”

strings.你三年前心梗，搭了两个支架，医生说再也不许进沙漠。你瞒着家里、也瞒着郑浩来了，因: Three years ago you had a heart attack and got two stents; the doctor said never set foot in a desert again. You hid it from your family and from Howard Zheng and came anyway, because the family's in debt. Three nitroglycerin tablets left in your pocket.
strings.你们城里人开几十万的车进来送死，图个啥嘛？: You city people drive in here in cars worth hundreds of thousands just to die. What for?
strings.你们开车的进来一趟，湖底下就多一道车辙，几十年都消不掉。: Every time you drivers come through, the lakebed keeps one more set of tire tracks that won't fade for decades.
strings.你能多喝一口，他欠你一个秘密: One extra mouthful for you, and he owes you a secret.
strings.你那辆车后备箱的地板下面有个暗格，装着一个车载小冰箱：八瓶苏打水、四罐红牛、一袋: Under the trunk floor of your car there's a hidden compartment with a small car fridge in it: eight bottles of soda water, four cans of Red Bull, a bag of beef jerky, and two chocolate bars (about 6 L of water, 1,500 kcal). You told no one.
strings.保住改行程单的秘密，活着出去: Keep the doctored route secret, get out alive.
strings.保护区巡护队的车，一般礼拜三从北边过来。今天礼拜几了？: The reserve patrol usually comes down from the north on Wednesdays. What day is it today?
strings.保护区的巡护队后来在北边一条雅丹沟里找到了那辆盖着帆布的破五十铃皮卡，车斗里的三: The reserve patrol later found the beat-up Isuzu pickup under its canvas tarp in a yardang gully to the north; the three woven sacks in the bed became evidence in a relics case. As for the driver — the plates were fake, and the name probably was too. No driver in Dunhuang ever delivered parts to the potash plant.
strings.修车会顺利得多；陆子昂会恨投赞成票的人: Repairs will go far more smoothly; Ryan Lu will hate whoever voted yes.
strings.倒进蒸馏坑里慢慢蒸: Pour it into the distillation pit and let it evaporate slowly.
strings.倒进蒸馏坑，让太阳把里面的水蒸出来: Pour it into the distillation pit and let the sun steam the water out.
strings.做户外纪录视频的博主，这次是郑浩的俱乐部请来做宣传的。相机和云台从不离手，还背着: An outdoor documentary vlogger, brought along by Howard Zheng's club this time to shoot promo. The camera and gimbal are never set down; there's a drone and two batteries in the pack as well.
strings.偷 GPS 的事，所有人都知道了。唐小禾回学校以后转去了地质灾害方向，每年暑假都: Everyone knew about the stolen GPS. Back at school, Holly Tang switched to geological hazards and spent every summer break volunteering with a rescue team. When someone asked her why, she said: “That day in the car, the first person I thought of was myself. I want to learn a skill that keeps me from thinking that way next time.”
strings.傍晚有人再去看，他已经没有气了，手里还攥着那只空瓶子。大家用沙子把他埋在了那座雅: When someone went to check at dusk, he had stopped breathing, the empty bottle still clutched in his hand. They buried him in the sand behind that yardang and planted his trekking pole over the grave.
strings.傍晚有人再去看，他竟然自己挪到了营地边上，靠着车轮坐着，手里攥着那只空瓶子。他说: When someone went to check at dusk, he had somehow dragged himself to the edge of camp and was sitting propped against a wheel, the empty bottle still in his fist. He said his name was Chris Ho.
strings.傍晚，大家掀开蒸馏坑上的薄膜，从坑底的杯子里倒出了今天的收成：一共 {var.s: At dusk everyone peeled the film off the distillation pit and poured the day's yield from the cup at the bottom: {var.still_yield} in all.
strings.兄弟，罗布泊里头，谁也不认识谁。出去以后，你们没见过我，我也没见过你们。: Brother, out here in Lop Nur nobody knows anybody. Once we're out of here, you never saw me and I never saw you.
strings.先不拆，用普拉多自己的东西凑合修: Don't strip it — make do with the Prado's own parts.
strings.先交给老韩保管，出去再说: Give it to Old Han to hold on to; we'll settle it once we're out.
strings.先别吵，今天多烧点东西，让他们往这边看: Quit arguing. Burn more today and get them looking this way.
strings.先别急，等把路探清楚再走: Hold on — scout the route clear before we move.
strings.先把所有的水集中起来，定好怎么分: Pool all the water first, then settle how to divide it.
strings.先把遮阳棚搭结实: Get the sunshade up solid first.
strings.先拍一段，再过去: Shoot some footage first, then go over.
strings.先拔了他的车钥匙，再谈帮不帮: Take his keys first, then talk about helping.
strings.先救人，别的以后再说: Save him first. Everything else later.
strings.先留着，万一呢: Keep it for now. Just in case.
strings.免得自己，也免得别人: For your own sake, and everyone else's.
strings.全倒掉，免得有人忍不住: Dump it all, before someone gives in.
strings.全躲进车里，关紧车窗: Everyone into the cars, windows shut tight.
strings.再往下挖，看看能不能挖出水来: Dig deeper. See if water comes up.
strings.再等等，留在车旁更安全: Wait a little longer — staying by the cars is safer.
strings.冒着风把蒸馏坑、SOS 和遮阳棚压牢: In the wind, weight down the distillation pit, the SOS, and the sunshade.
strings.冲出沙海: Breaking Out of the Sea of Sand
strings.冲过去一把拉开车门: Dash over and yank the door open.
strings.几个人交换了一下眼色，朝皮卡围了过去。: A few of them exchanged glances and closed in around the pickup.
strings.几个人用围巾裹住脸，趴在地上一块一块地压石头。: They wrapped scarves over their faces, lay flat on the ground, and weighted the stones down one by one.
strings.几个人跪在虚土里刨了两个多钟头，垫上石头和塑料布，皮卡吼了一声冲出了坑。汉子说他: They knelt in the soft dust and dug for over two hours, wedged stones and plastic sheeting underneath, and the pickup roared out of the hole. The man said he was Gary Ge, from Dunhuang, delivering parts to the potash plant, lost after taking a shortcut. He lifted a bucket of water down off the bed — and when he pulled the canvas back, something clanked underneath.
strings.几个压扁的馕和一包饼干: A few flattened naan and a packet of biscuits
strings.几桶苦水倒进了蒸馏坑的坑底。: Buckets of bitter water went into the bottom of the distillation pit.
strings.出汗逐小时计算：气温按昼夜曲线变化（凌晨十七八度，下午三点四十出头，热浪天四十五: Sweat loss, hour by hour: air temperature follows the day-night curve (17–18 °C before dawn, low forties by three in the afternoon, mid-forties on heatwave days), and sun exposure adds as much as 13 °C to the felt temperature. Lying in shade still costs 0.3–0.4 L of sweat an hour in the hottest part of the day — over four litres a day; heavy work under the noon sun, 1.5–2 L an hour.
strings.刀子下去，血流进了洗脸盆。有人把骆驼的瘤胃割开，用 T 恤把里面的糊糊一把一把地: The knife went in, and the blood ran into a washbasin. Someone cut open the camel's rumen and wrung the mush out through a T-shirt, handful by handful; the juice came out green, smelling of grass and sour rot. The meat was cut into strips and hung on the car door to dry.
strings.刮一点盐壳上的白霜舔: Scrape the white frost off the salt crust and lick it
strings.剪。多一口水是一口: Cut it. One more mouthful counts.
strings.半夜，{actor} 被一声轻响惊醒——陆子昂那辆车里传出“嗤”的一声，像是有人: In the middle of the night, {actor} was startled awake by a small sound — a hiss from inside Ryan Lu's car, like someone opening a can of drink.
strings.半夜，{actor} 被一阵刨土声吵醒。卡拉在营地西边一座雅丹的背阴脚下刨出了一: In the middle of the night, {actor} was woken by the sound of digging. Kara had scratched a half-meter pit at the shaded foot of a yardang west of camp, and was pushing his nose into the bottom of it, sniffing hard. {actor} reached out to feel — the sand at the bottom was damp, as cool as the rim of a well.
strings.半瓶伊力特灌下去，{protagonist} 呛得满脸通红，过了很久才睡着。: Half a bottle of Yilite went down, and {protagonist} choked red in the face; it was a long time before {protagonist.he} got to sleep.
strings.卡拉一纵身跳上了车斗，趴在帆布上，眼睛一直盯着驾驶室的后窗。: Kara sprang up into the truck bed in one leap, lay flat on the canvas, and kept his eyes fixed on the cab's rear window.
strings.卡拉忽然冲着北边低吼起来，背上的毛全竖了起来。: Kara suddenly started growling low at the north, the hair on his back standing straight up.
strings.卡拉死在了车底的阴影里，身子底下压着老买的一只鞋。后来有人用一块塑料布把它裹起来: Kara died in the shade under the car, one of Uncle Memet's shoes pinned beneath his body. Later someone wrapped him in a sheet of plastic and buried him at the foot of the tallest yardang beside camp, weighing the grave down with stones. Passing off-road convoys sometimes stop to photograph that pile of stones; nobody knows what is buried under it.
strings.卡拉没有跟上来。它趴在老买身边，一直望着手电光消失的方向。: Kara did not follow. He lay beside Uncle Memet, eyes fixed on where the flashlight beam had vanished.
strings.卡拉第一个冲了出去，围着一个高高的影子又跳又叫。: Kara was first out, leaping and barking around a tall shadow.
strings.卡拉跟着老买回了米兰镇。老买的腿瘸了，再也没进过沙漠，卡拉就天天卧在他家院门口的: Kara went back to Milan Township with Uncle Memet. Uncle Memet's leg left him lame, and he never went into the desert again; Kara lay every day under the mulberry tree at his gate. When strangers came asking the way to Lop Nur, he still went over to sniff at them first, then looked back at Uncle Memet.
strings.卫星电话不是翻车时摔坏的。出事前一天夜里，你偷偷借它给经纪人发消息谈广告，失手掉: The satellite phone was not broken in the rollover. The night before the crash, you secretly borrowed it to message your agent about a sponsorship deal and fumbled it onto the salt crust, cracking the screen. You shoved it back into Howard Zheng's bag and said nothing. If you had spoken up then, the convoy might never have pushed deeper.
strings.原型：1980 年 6 月，科学家彭加木在罗布泊东缘的库木库都克一带考察时，留下: Prototype: in June 1980, scientist Peng Jiamu was surveying the Kumukuduke area on the eastern edge of Lop Nur when he left camp alone with a note: “Going east to find a well.” He never came back, and several large searches never found him. In June 1996 the explorer Yu Chunshun lost his way walking across Lop Nur and died a few kilometers from a supply point. For years after, illegal convoys kept coming into Lop Nur and the Kumtag Desert — bogging down, getting lost, running dry: those who stayed with their vehicles and burned tires were found; some of those who walked away never came out. “Stay with the vehicle”; “shade by day, move by night”; “limit sweat, not water” — principles bought with lives.
strings.去东边找苦水井: Head east for the bitter well
strings.去看看，万一是真的: Go have a look. What if it's real?
strings.去苦水井背水: Haul water back from the bitter well
strings.又咸又苦，说不定越喝越渴: Salty and bitter — may only leave you thirstier.
strings.双层塑料布、架空、刨掉烫沙。白天躲在下面休息能少出很多汗: Two layers of plastic, raised off the ground, hot sand scraped away. Rest under it by day and you lose far less sweat.
strings.只能给四升，多一口都没有: Four liters, and not a mouthful more.
strings.只认老买和老韩；白天趴在车底的阴影里一动不动，天黑以后才出去转，回来时嘴上常沾着: Only recognizes Uncle Memet and Old Han; lies motionless in the shade under the car all day, only slips out after dark, often coming back with sand on his muzzle. Growls at strangers; never begs for food.
strings.只顾着死死拽住遮阳棚: Just hangs on to the sunshade for dear life.
strings.叫声又长又哑，像人在哭。: The call was long and hoarse, like a person weeping.
strings.后半夜，何川自己走了。他只拿了三瓶水，在棚子的柱子上用石子划了一行字：“莫等我，: In the small hours, Chris Ho left on his own. He took only three bottles of water, and scratched a line into the shelter post with a stone: “Don't wait for me. Wait for the car.”
strings.后半夜，北边亮起两道车灯，在雅丹之间摇摇晃晃地拐了几个弯，在一里开外停住，再也不: In the small hours, two headlights rose in the north, swaying through the bends between the yardangs, then stopped half a kilometer off and moved no more — a beat-up pickup under a canvas tarp, bogged in the soft dust. A middle-aged man with a cloth wrapped around his head came over with a flashlight, camo jacket crusted white with salt: “Brother, my truck's stuck. Help me push it out. I've got water — a bucket for you.”
strings.后半夜，小骆驼像是闻到了什么，猛地一甩头挣断了缰绳，朝东边跑得没了影，两桶水也跟: In the small hours the camel calf caught a scent of something, flung her head and snapped the halter rope, and bolted east out of sight; two buckets of water went with her. {actor} chased after her a long while, then had no choice but to follow {actor.his} own footprints back to camp.
strings.后备箱暗格的事，后来成了车队群里一个谁也笑不出来的笑话。陆子昂给每个人转了一笔钱: The hidden compartment became a joke in the convoy group chat that nobody could laugh at. Ryan Lu sent each of them money, the note always the same: “Sorry about those bottles of soda water.” Half of it came back. As for the other half, he never worked up the nerve to ask who had kept it.
strings.后备箱角落里一个没摔烂的西瓜: A watermelon in a corner of the trunk that didn't get smashed.
strings.唐小禾回到学校，把课程论文的题目改成了《罗布泊东北部雅丹区太阳能蒸馏的实际产水量: Back at school, Holly Tang changed her term paper title to “Actual Water Yield of Solar Stills in the Yardang Zone of Northeastern Lop Nur” and got an A. She never said a word about the GPS. Later she had a new one sent to Uncle Memet's home in Milan Township, unsigned.
strings.唐小禾在图的边角上找到一个标着“苦井”的小圆圈，旁边还有一条虚线往东北延伸。: In a corner of the map, Holly Tang found a small circle marked “Bitter Well,” with a dotted line running northeast beside it.
strings.唐小禾在手电光下摊开那张卷了边的地质图。: Holly Tang spread the dog-eared geological map out in the flashlight beam.
strings.唐小禾是一个人消失在沙海里的。她的罗盘后来在东北方向二十多公里的地方被人捡到，指: Holly Tang vanished into the sea of sand alone. Her compass was later picked up more than twenty kilometers to the northeast, its needle still turning. The school held her enrollment for three years; in the fourth year, a freshman moved into her bed in the dormitory.
strings.唐小禾是坐着那辆破皮卡先走的人。车开出营地的时候，她一直扭着头往后看，直到营地的: Holly Tang was the one who left first, in the beat-up pickup. As it pulled out of camp she kept her head twisted around, watching until the campfire was out of sight. Back at school, she wrote every name from that night's vote on the first page of her notebook.
strings.唐小禾的那本《罗布泊科学考察记》后来被人从营地带了出来，书页里夹着一张写满公式的: Holly Tang's copy of Scientific Survey of Lop Nur was later carried out of camp; tucked between the pages was a sheet covered in formulas — the area of the stills, the angle of the sun, how many milliliters a day they could catch. Her advisor photocopied it and taped it to the lab wall.
strings.嗡嗡声越来越远，最后什么也听不见了。: The buzzing faded, farther and farther, until nothing could be heard at all.
strings.嘴里干得粘成一片，舌头像块砂纸。有人小声说：书上写着，实在不行可以喝尿。: Their mouths were so dry they glued shut, tongues like sandpaper. Someone said in a low voice: the book says when it comes down to it, you can drink urine.
strings.四个人一人拽着一个角，整整拽了几个小时。: Four people, one corner each, dragged for hours on end.
strings.四个人轮流架着他走回了营地。有人往一升水里撒了一小撮盐、倒了半包白糖，托着他的头: Four people took turns supporting him back to camp. Someone stirred a pinch of salt and half a packet of sugar into a liter of water and tipped it into his mouth spoonful by spoonful, cradling his head. At noon he came to once and fished a phone out of his shirt pocket: on the screen was a track coming down from Lop Nur Town in the north. He said his name was Chris Ho.
strings.四升水只装了半个水袋。何川说：“够了，余纯顺那会儿还没得这么多。”: Four liters filled only half the water bag. Chris Ho said: “Plenty. Yu Chunshun didn't have near this much.”
strings.四周是一望无际的白色盐壳和被风削成的土丘（雅丹）。一辆车陷在虚土里，一辆侧翻在四: All around stretched white salt crust to the horizon and wind-sculpted mounds (yardangs). One vehicle bogged in the soft dust, one lying on its side at the bottom of a yardang gully four or five meters deep. Thirty or forty kilometers to the northeast there is said to be a potash haul road.
strings.四箱矿泉水，加上一桶半桶装水（另一桶翻车时摔裂了），都晒得发烫。: Four cases of bottled water, plus one and a half barrels (the other barrel cracked in the rollover) — all of it baking hot.
strings.图上的地名和眼前的雅丹怎么也对不上。唐小禾把图折好，说她也不确定。: None of the place names on the map lined up with the yardangs in front of them. Holly Tang folded the map away and said she wasn't sure either.
strings.图是老的，可总比一个烧糊涂的人靠谱: The map is old, but it beats a man raving with fever
strings.在三公里外的一座雅丹背后，他们找到了蜷成一团的 {protagonist}，把带: Behind a yardang three kilometers out they found {protagonist} curled into a ball, fed {protagonist.him} every drop of the water they had carried, mouthful by mouthful, then dug a sand pit in the shade and waited for dark to carry {protagonist.him} back.
strings.在乌鲁木齐开越野俱乐部，号称穿越过十几次沙漠。这趟“深度穿越罗布泊”每人收了八千: Runs an off-road club in Urumqi, claims he has crossed the desert a dozen times over. This “deep crossing of Lop Nur” cost 8,800 yuan a head. When it went wrong he was out front scouting in the old Prado, and it rolled into a yardang gully.
strings.在南疆线上跑了三十年大车，年轻时给石油勘探队开过沙漠车，跟老向导买买提是几十年的: Thirty years hauling freight on the southern Xinjiang routes; as a young man he drove desert trucks for an oil survey crew, and he has known Uncle Memet the guide for decades. Steady, a man of few words. On the day of the crash he was the one shouting at Ryan Lu to stop flooring it.
strings.在盐壳上摆 SOS: Spell SOS on the salt crust
strings.地质专业大二学生，在网上搭的车: Geology sophomore who found the ride online.
strings.塑料布被剪成了几块，头顶的阴影一下子小了一半。: The plastic sheet was cut into pieces, and the shade overhead shrank by half.
strings.塑料布还撑在头顶上。: The plastic sheet was still up overhead.
strings.外界的搜救投入。家属报警之前是 0。: Outside rescue effort. Zero until the families report you missing.
strings.外面已经在找了，这是好消息: They're already searching out there — that's good news
strings.外面的人也许已经在找了: Maybe they're already out there looking
strings.多一分把握，可水不等人: One more bit of certainty; but the water won't wait
strings.多喂水，让毒排出去: Keep the water going and flush the poison out
strings.多喝点水就好了: Just drink more water and it'll be fine
strings.夜里刨两个钟头沙子，人人一身汗；可他有水，也有一辆能开的车: Two hours of digging sand at night and everyone's soaked in sweat; but he has water, and a car that runs
strings.夜里去苦水井，把空水桶灌满再背回来。来回二十多公里，背着水走后半程很要命。井水又: Go to the bitter well at night, fill the empty barrels and carry them back. Twenty-odd kilometers round trip, and the second half with water on your back is murder. The well water is bitter and salty; drink too much and you get the runs. You can only set out at night.
strings.夜里走过的地方: What the night walk turned up
strings.夜里，{actor} 一个人缩在车后面，借着屏幕的微光看那台偷来的 GPS：来时: At night {actor} huddled alone behind the car with the stolen GPS, reading the track in the screen's faint glow: the way in was clear as day, one bar of battery left. If {actor.he} walked out now, alone…
strings.夜里，唐小禾讲起了彭加木：1980 年夏天，就在离这里不远的地方，他留下一张字条: That night Holly Tang told them about Peng Jiamu: in the summer of 1980, not far from here, he left a note — “Going east to find a well” — and walked into the desert alone. He never came back.
strings.夜里，热气终于退了。沙漠的星空低得像要压下来，银河从一座雅丹顶上一直铺到另一座。: At night the heat finally let go. The desert sky hung so low it seemed about to press down, the Milky Way laid from the top of one yardang to the next.
strings.大家从工具箱里翻出一卷胶布和一截铁丝，叹了口气。: They dug a roll of tape and a length of wire out of the toolbox and sighed.
strings.大家会照着轨迹找路，也会知道你干了什么: They'll follow the track and find the way out; they'll also know what you did
strings.大家决定哪儿也不去：白天躲在棚子底下，夜里出来干活、点火。: They decided to go nowhere: hide under the shelter by day, come out at night to work and light fires.
strings.大家决定天黑以后一起走。没有人去看躺在车影里的老买。: They decided to leave together after dark. Nobody looked at Uncle Memet lying in the shadow of the car.
strings.大家决定：天黑以后选一个人出发。: They decided: after dark, one person sets out.
strings.大家决定：天黑以后，选一个人出发。: They decided: once it was dark, one person would set out.
strings.大家在水桶上贴了纸条：一份苦水，兑一份好水。: They taped a note to the water barrel: one part bitter water to one part good water.
strings.大家扶着 {protagonist}，一口一口地喂水。: They held {protagonist} up and fed {protagonist.him} water, mouthful by mouthful.
strings.大家把 {protagonist} 拖进车底的阴影里，谁也没去动那箱水。: They dragged {protagonist} into the shade under the car. Nobody touched the case of water.

strings.大家缩在棚子底下，谁也没说话，一遍遍地往东北方向看。: They huddled under the shelter, nobody speaking, looking northeast again and again.
strings.大家能照着轨迹找路，你的秘密也许能保住: They'll find the way along the track — your secret might stay safe

strings.天上传来“嗡嗡”的声音——一个小黑点在很远的南边慢慢飞过，像是一架小飞机，又像是: A “buzz” came from the sky — a small black dot crawling across the far south, like a light plane, or a drone.
strings.天亮了，{protagonist} 没有回来。太阳一出来，盐壳上就像下了火。一个: Dawn came and {protagonist} had not come back. The moment the sun rose, the salt crust was like a bed of fire. A person alone out there won't last past noon.
strings.天亮了，葛长贵蹲在皮卡边上抽完了一根烟：“驾驶室能挤两个人。老人家伤成这样，我先: At daybreak Gary Ge finished a cigarette squatting beside the pickup: “The cab can squeeze in two. The old man's hurt this bad, so I take him first, then one more, drop you at the potash plant clinic, and report it for you. Fuel and trouble, 20,000 yuan. Transfer it to me once we're somewhere with a signal.” While he talked, his eyes kept sliding to the canvas over the truck bed.
strings.天亮前，{actor} 一瘸一拐地回来了：GPS 在半路没了电。她手里还攥着那台: Before dawn {actor} limped back: the GPS had died halfway. {actor.he} was still clutching the black-screened device — everyone saw it.
strings.天亮前，{actor} 拖着一辆两轮拉车回来了，车把上还系着那件红冲锋衣。车上的: Before dawn {actor} came back dragging a two-wheeled handcart, the red shell jacket still tied to the handlebars. The buckets on it were baking hot, and not one drop had leaked.
strings.天亮的时候，一辆拉钾盐的重卡在便道上急刹。司机看见一个人从沙梁后面跌跌撞撞地冲出: At daybreak a potash truck slammed to a stop on the haul road. The driver saw a figure come staggering out from behind a sand ridge, repeating one sentence over and over: “Southwest… there are others…” That afternoon the rescue vehicle followed the footprints to camp. Survivors: {survivors}.
strings.天刚蒙蒙亮，有人在东边两公里外的一座雅丹背后发现了一个人：二十多岁，裹着防晒头套: Just before dawn someone found a man behind a yardang two kilometers to the east: mid-twenties, wrapped in a sun hood, the soles of his hiking boots worn through, his water bag long since flat. His skin was dry and burning and he had stopped sweating; he only groaned when spoken to, and the one sentence he kept repeating was: “The handcart… my handcart…”
strings.天是土黄色的，太阳像一只发白的盘子，细沙钻进衣服和鼻孔。: The sky was the color of dust, the sun a whitish disc, fine sand working into clothes and nostrils.
strings.天蓝得发白，盐壳反着刺眼的光，正午的地表能到七十度。: The sky was a blue bleached almost white, the salt crust throwing back a blinding glare; at noon the ground could reach 70 °C.
strings.天还没亮，卡拉就冲着东边叫个不停，叫一阵，跑出去一段，又跑回来扯人的裤腿。: Before it was light Kara was barking at the east and would not stop — a spell of barking, a dash out, then back to tug at someone's trouser leg.
strings.天黑了。小骆驼背上挂着两桶水，不安地刨着蹄子。推选一个人牵着它，连夜朝东北走：骆: It was dark. Two buckets of water hung on the camel calf's back and she pawed the ground, restless. Choose one person to lead her northeast through the night: a camel knows the way back to her herd, and a man knows the North Star. Before dawn, either you get there, or you turn back.
strings.天黑了，葛长贵发动了皮卡。驾驶室里除了他，只能再挤两个人：老买要是还活着，先把他: It was dark, and Gary Ge started the pickup. Besides him, the cab could squeeze in only two more: if Uncle Memet was still alive, he went up first; the remaining seat was for the group to vote on. Who goes, who stays?
strings.天黑了，风终于凉了下来。推选一个人，带上六升水、手电和指北针，连夜往东北走，去找: It was dark, and the wind had finally turned cool. Choose one person with six liters of water, a flashlight and a compass, and walk northeast through the night to find the potash haul road. Before dawn, either you get there, or you turn back.
strings.天黑以后，何川把鞋带系了又系：“我一个人走了四百多公里，晓得在沙漠里怎么走路。给: After dark Chris Ho retied his laces again and again: “I walked four hundred-odd kilometers by myself. I know how to walk in a desert. Give me eight liters and I'll head northeast tonight; two nights at most and I can reach the potash plant's haul road and bring help back. You stay by the car. Don't go wandering.”
strings.天黑以后，老买醒了一阵。他抓着身边人的手，汉话里夹着维吾尔语，断断续续地说：东边: After dark Uncle Memet woke for a while. He gripped the hand of whoever was beside him and spoke in broken snatches, Chinese mixed with Uyghur: east… there's a bitter well, dug by the survey team back then; walk northeast one night and you'll strike the potash truck road… Then he sank back into sleep.
strings.天黑前推选谁坐那个座位；剩下的人等他报警: Vote before dark on who gets the seat; the rest wait for him to raise the alarm
strings.天黑后推选人选。夜里赶路凉快，可方向一错就回不来: Vote after dark. Night walking is cool, but one wrong heading and you don't come back
strings.天黑后推选人选。走的人九死一生，可这也许是唯一的机会: Vote after dark. Whoever walks has one chance in ten — but it may be the only chance you get
strings.天黑透了，风凉了下来。每个人都背上了水和手电。老买躺在车边，眼睛一直跟着大家转。: Full dark, and the wind had turned cool. Everyone had water and a flashlight on their backs. Uncle Memet lay by the car, his eyes following them everywhere. Were they really going?
strings.太远了，看不见我们的: Too far — they won't see us
strings.太阳晒得人发昏，火气也上来了。陆子昂冲郑浩吼：“你是领队！你带的什么破路！”郑浩: The sun baked everyone stupid and tempers rose with it. Ryan Lu yelled at Howard Zheng: “You're the trip leader! What kind of route did you bring us on!” Howard Zheng yelled back: “If you hadn't driven that car into the ground, we'd have been out of here long ago!”
strings.太阳能蒸馏坑每个每天只能接 0.2–0.4 升水（倒进尿或防冻液能多一点），坑底: A solar still catches only 0.2–0.4 L of water a day (a little more if you pour in urine or antifreeze), and the sand at the bottom dries out in two or three days. strings.如果人还清醒，会朝着烟走: If he's still clear-headed, he'll walk toward the smoke

strings.存储卡没能带出来，苏芮也再没拍过沙漠。她后来在电视台做剪辑，剪的都是别人的故事。: The memory card never made it out, and Ruby Su never filmed a desert again. She went to work as a TV editor, cutting other people's stories. strings.家里做煤矿生意，开着他爸刚改装好的陆地巡洋舰来“玩沙”，一路冲沙丘、拍视频。车陷: His family is in the coal business; he came out to “play in the sand” in his father's freshly modified Land Cruiser, charging dunes and shooting video the whole way. strings.小药瓶上写着“硝酸甘油”。药片压在舌头底下，过了十几分钟，老韩的脸色才慢慢缓了过: The little bottle said “Nitroglycerin.” The tablet went under his tongue, and a quarter of an hour later the color slowly came back into Old Han's face.
strings.小骆驼一看见艾山的骆驼，就“嗷”地叫着挣了过去。: The moment the camel calf spotted Aishan's camels she bawled and pulled toward them.
strings.小骆驼最后自己回到了阿奇克谷地的驼群——骆驼认得回家的路，哪怕隔着几十公里的盐壳: In the end the camel calf made her own way back to the herd in Aqqik Valley — a camel knows the road home, even across dozens of kilometers of salt crust. Aishan told people later that the calf he lost that summer had walked back out from inside Lop Nur, with half a nylon rope nobody could account for still tied on her back.
strings.小骆驼没能离开营地。它的骨架后来被风沙磨得发白，就躺在雅丹沟边上。阿奇克谷地的牧: The camel calf never left camp. Wind and sand scoured her bones white where they lay at the edge of the yardang gully. When Aishan, a herder from Aqqik Valley, found her, he untied the faded red rag from her ear and tucked it into his coat.
strings.小骆驼被艾山牵回了阿奇克谷地的驼群。第二年开春，它的脖子上多了一个小铜铃。艾山说: Aishan led the camel calf back to the herd in Aqqik Valley. The next spring there was a little brass bell on her neck. Aishan said this was a camel that had walked out from inside Lop Nur, so it had to ring with every step, to let people know.

strings.座椅底下、沟底的沙子里，又找到几瓶矿泉水: A few more bottles of water under the seats and in the sand at the bottom of the gully

strings.开破皮卡的敦煌人，自称给钾盐厂送配件: The Dunhuang man in the beat-up pickup who claims to deliver parts to the potash plant.

strings.当天夜里，有人开始头疼、看东西发花——玻璃水里果然有甲醇。: That night, someone's head began to ache and their vision blurred — there really was methanol in the windshield washer fluid.
strings.很少叫。真叫起来，一定是远处有东西。: Barks rarely. When he does, there's something out there.

strings.快到中午，南边的地平线上浮起一片亮晃晃的水面，水边像是还有一排房子。有人跳了起来: Toward noon a sheet of dazzling water rose off the southern horizon, and along its edge there even seemed to be a row of houses. Someone jumped up: “A lake! There are people over there!”
strings.快到中午，卡拉从车底爬了出来，走了两步就侧躺在滚烫的盐壳上，舌头发紫，喘得像拉风: Toward noon Kara crawled out from under the car, took two steps, and lay down on his side on the scorching salt crust, tongue gone purple, panting like a bellows, a row of blisters raised on his paw pads. Dogs don't sweat — they shed heat by panting alone, and he can't last much longer.
strings.我跟你说嘛，白天动一下，就是往沙子里倒水。躺到，莫动。: I'm telling you, moving an inch in daylight is pouring water into the sand. Lie down. Don't move.
strings.我这条腿，不行了。你们，莫管我。: My leg, it's done for. You all, don't mind me.
strings.我那辆拉车上还有三十几升水……就在一座像船的雅丹底下。: There's still thirty-odd liters of water on my handcart… right under a yardang shaped like a boat.
strings.所有人举起镜子和锅盖朝它晃: Everyone wave mirrors and pot lids at it
strings.所有人挤上车，一起冲出去: Everyone pile in and charge out together
strings.所有人挤进了车里。握方向盘的人深吸一口气，挂上了低速四驱。: Everyone squeezed into the car. Whoever had the wheel took a deep breath and shifted into low-range four-wheel drive.
strings.所有的水都码在了普拉多的后座底下。郑浩拿马克笔在纸箱上写了个数：{res.wat: All the water was stacked under the Prado's back seat. Howard Zheng wrote a number on the cardboard box with a marker: {res.water}.
strings.手摇收音机里，若羌台的新闻断断续续：“……一支越野车队失联……搜救人员正沿哈罗公: On the hand-crank radio the Ruoqiang station's news came through in broken scraps: “…an off-road convoy out of contact… searchers are working both sides of the Hami–Lop Nur Highway…” The highway was more than a hundred kilometers away. Everyone looked at Howard Zheng.

strings.找的人也要顶着太阳走，可能再搭进去一个: Whoever goes walks under that sun too — you might lose another one
strings.承认是自己拿的，把 GPS 交出来: Admit you took it and hand over the GPS

strings.把两辆车里里外外、沟底散落的行李翻一遍：也许还有水、吃的、能用的工具。车里中午像: Go through both vehicles, inside and out, and the luggage scattered on the gully floor: there may still be water, food, usable tools. At noon the cars are like steamers, and the longer you wait, the less there is left to find.

strings.拉车上的水够他走到大路；可他刚从热射病里捡回一条命，找不到车就是死路: The water on the handcart is enough to carry him to the main road; but he has only just clawed his way back from heatstroke, and if he never finds that cart, it's certain death
