strings.拿一升半水浇它的肚皮和爪子，再喂几口: Pour a liter and a half of water over Kara's belly and paws, then give him a few mouthfuls.
strings.拿上三瓶水，一个人照着轨迹走: Take three bottles of water and follow the track alone
strings.拿瓶子、锅、车顶接: Catch it with bottles, pots, and the car roof
strings.拿走他的手机和 GPS——人，带不动了: Take his phone and GPS — he can't be carried any farther.
strings.挖一个一米宽、半米深的坑，中间放杯子，盖上薄膜，压一块石头。太阳一晒，湿沙里的水: Dig a pit a meter wide, half a meter deep; set a cup in the middle, cover it with film and weight the film with a stone. Sun on the damp sand drives vapor up; it condenses on the film and drips into the cup. One pit catches only 200 to 300 ml a day. Digging by day (morning) costs two or three extra liters of sweat, more than the pit yields in days; dig at night and it is cooler, but no water comes until the next day. Uses 1 sheet of plastic.
strings.挖到一米深，坑底渗出了一汪浑黄的水。{actor} 捧起来抿了一口——又苦又涩，: {actor} dug down a meter, and a pool of muddy yellow water seeped out at the bottom of the pit. {actor} cupped some up and took a sip — bitter and harsh, {actor.his} tongue smarting as if something had stung it. It was brine from under the salt lake, several times saltier than seawater. But this patch of wet sand is worth remembering: future stills can be dug here.
strings.挖开车身下的土，用千斤顶和拖车绳把侧翻的普拉多一点点掀回来，再挖一条能开出沟的坡: Dig the earth out from under the body, use jacks and tow straps to lever the overturned Prado back onto its wheels bit by bit, then cut a ramp it can be driven out through.
strings.捏着鼻子喝下去: Pinch your nose and drink it
strings.捡到何川的重卡司机说，他从沙梁后面扑出来的时候，嘴唇裂得说不出话，手里攥着一张烟: The truck driver who picked up Chris Ho said he came bursting out from behind a sand ridge with his lips cracked so badly he could not speak, clutching a cigarette-pack wrapper with the camp's position drawn on it in ballpoint. He later opened a tiny outdoor gear shop in Chongqing, a hand-drawn map of Lop Nur on the wall with a red circle in the northeast corner. Asked what that place was, he said: “The best night's walk I ever had.”
strings.换电瓶、补机油、校正撞弯的转向拉杆、缠好漏液的水管。: Swap the battery, top off the oil, true up the bent tie rod, and tape the leaking hose.
strings.换电瓶、补机油、校正撞弯的转向拉杆、缠好漏液的水管。老韩这样的老司机干起来快得多: Swap the battery, top off the oil, true up the bent tie rod, and tape the leaking hose. An old hand like Old Han gets through it far faster. Down in the gully the body of the vehicle blocks the sun, which beats baking out on the salt crust.
strings.掀开帆布：所有人都挤上车斗，一起走: Roll back the canvas: everyone cram into the truck bed and go together
strings.搜救报告里写得清清楚楚：报备线路和实际线路差了一百多公里。郑浩被罚了二十万，俱乐: The rescue report laid it out plainly: the filed route and the actual route differed by more than a hundred kilometers. Howard Zheng was fined 200,000 yuan, the club had its license revoked, and he was left carrying a major-negligence case. When his suspended sentence ended, he went to Ruoqiang to drive a truck hauling potash, on the very haul road no one had managed to find that year.
strings.搜救车队把营地里的人一个不少地拉出了罗布泊。医生说，再晚一天，至少有两个人会肾衰: The rescue convoy pulled every last person out of the camp and out of Lop Nur. The doctor said that a day later, at least two of them would have gone into kidney failure. Howard Zheng's club had its license revoked, and fine notices were mailed to every home. Nobody complained — to get a fine and still be alive is luck enough.
strings.搜救队找到了营地。活着被抬上车的人是：{survivors}。留在盐壳上的，还有: The search team found the camp. Those carried out alive were: {survivors}. Those left behind on the salt crust: {dead}. Later, when people asked about those days, the survivors said only: the sun was too fierce, and there was too little water.
strings.搜救队找的地方离你们有多近（1 = 方向对了）。: How close the search team's search came to you (1 = the direction was right).
strings.搜救：家属哪天报警、搜救队找的方向对不对，都是隐藏的。被发现的概率 = 搜救力度: Search and rescue: which day the families report you missing, and whether the search team looks in the right direction, are both hidden. Chance of being found = search effort × direction × (ground signals + this turn's black smoke, firelight, mirror flashes) × visibility. At night a single burning tire can be seen twenty or thirty kilometers away; in a sandstorm, nothing can be seen at all.
strings.搬水的时候，有人在陆子昂车的后备箱地板下面摸到了一个暗格。: While they were moving the water, someone's hand found a hidden compartment under the floor of Ryan Lu's trunk.
strings.收好，谁也不告诉: Stow it away and tell no one
strings.改行程单的事，始终没人说破。俱乐部关了半年，换了个名字又开张了，宣传册上多了一行: Nobody ever said out loud that the itinerary sheet had been altered. The club shut down for half a year, reopened under a new name, and the brochure gained a bold new line: “Never enter the core zone of the reserve.” Only Howard Zheng knew that the filed form reading the Hami–Lop Nur Highway was still locked in his office drawer, never thrown away.
strings.放下相机，过去抱住他: Put down the camera and go hold him
strings.放它走，记下它往哪边去: Let her go and note which way she heads
strings.放无人机侦察: Send up the drone to scout
strings.敏锐、好强、镜头感极强，越危险越兴奋；会照顾人，却总是下意识地先把镜头对准别人的: Sharp, competitive, with a born eye for a shot; the more dangerous it gets, the more excited she is. She takes care of people, yet her first instinct is always to turn the lens on someone else's pain. She knows perfectly well that this footage could make her a household name.
strings.敦煌人，开一辆车斗盖着帆布的破五十铃皮卡，说自己是给钾盐厂送配件的，抄近道陷在了: A Dunhuang man in a battered Isuzu pickup with a canvas over the bed, who says he delivers parts to the potash plant and got his shortcut bogged down in the soft dust. He knows these yardangs strangely well: which gully a vehicle can pass through, and which day the reserve patrols come by.
strings.新疆若羌县，罗布泊湖心东北的雅丹区边缘: Ruoqiang County, Xinjiang: the edge of the yardang zone northeast of the Lop Nur lake center
strings.方向感最好的那个人把何川的手机揣进怀里，灌满一壶水，打着手电出发了。: The one with the best sense of direction tucked Chris Ho's phone against his chest, filled a canteen, and set off with a flashlight.
strings.无人机的画面里，东边的盐壳上有一个圆圆的黑点，像是一圈井框。: On the drone's feed, there was a round black spot on the salt crust to the east, like the ring of a well frame.
strings.早上，一峰小骆驼从东边的雅丹之间晃了出来：一岁多，鼻栓上拴着半截断缰绳，左耳上系: In the morning a camel calf came wandering out from among the eastern yardangs: a little over a year old, a broken half-rein on her nose peg, a faded red rag tied to her left ear — she had an owner. Her four legs were caked with gray mud, and she bawled at the camp, a sound like a person crying.
strings.是陆子昂把车踩废的: It was Ryan Lu who drove the car into the ground.
strings.普拉多侧翻在四五米深的雅丹沟里。要先挖开车身下的土，用千斤顶和拖车绳一点点把它掀: The Prado lay on its side in a yardang gully four or five meters deep. First dig the earth out from under the body, then lever it back onto its wheels with jacks and tow straps, a little at a time, and cut a ramp out of the gully. It takes several people, several rounds of work. Digging by day (morning) costs two or three extra liters of sweat and risks heatstroke; digging at night, about a liter and a half.
strings.普拉多在虚土和盐壳上颠了一整夜，水温表一直贴着红线。天快亮时，车灯照到了一根歪倒: The Prado bucked over soft dust and salt crust the whole night through, the temperature gauge pressed against the red line. Just before dawn the headlights caught a leaning milestone. At noon that day, the rescue vehicles followed the tire tracks to camp. Survivors: {survivors}.
strings.普拉多的发动机轰轰地响着。油箱里能加的汽油还有 {res.fuel}。从这里到大: The Prado's engine rumbles. There is {res.fuel} of usable gasoline left in the tank. From here to the truck road lies dozens of kilometers of soft dust and salt crust.
strings.普拉多的备胎，加上陆子昂那辆车的四条轮胎和备胎。烧起来白天冒黑烟，夜里是一团火。: The Prado's spare tire, plus the four tires and the spare off Ryan Lu's vehicle. Burned, it makes black smoke by day and a ball of fire by night.
strings.普拉多终于四个轮子着地了！可翻车时电瓶漏光了液，机油也洒了大半。懂车的人看了一圈: The Prado was finally back on all four wheels! But in the rollover the battery had leaked dry and most of the oil was gone. Someone who knew engines looked it over: to get it started, they would have to pull the battery and the oil off Ryan Lu's vehicle. Ryan Lu shot to his feet: “That's my dad's car! If we strip it, how am I supposed to explain it when I get home?”
strings.普通话很标准，说话小心翼翼，爱说“书上说……”。: Standard Mandarin, spoken carefully; fond of saying “the book says…”.
strings.暑假想来看罗布泊干涸的湖床，为课程论文找素材，只付了一份油钱就搭上了车队。瘦小，: Came during summer break to see the dried-up lakebed of Lop Nur and gather material for a term paper, paying only a share of the fuel to ride along with the convoy. Small and slight, not much of a talker; in her bag are a compass, an old geological map, and a worn-out copy of Scientific Survey of Lop Nur.
strings.最快的降温办法，但要用掉 3 升水: The fastest way to cool down, but it costs 3 liters of water
strings.最醒目，轮胎会少一条: The most conspicuous, but it costs a tire
strings.最高的那座雅丹顶上，手机跳出过一格信号: On top of the tallest yardang, the phone once caught a single bar of signal
strings.有一个坑底的沙子已经被晒干了，再也蒸不出水来。: One pit had baked dry at the bottom and would never give up water again.
strings.有人一下子跪在了盐壳上。艾山赶紧把他扶起来，把水囊塞进他怀里：“喝，喝。电话，我: Someone dropped to his knees on the salt crust. Aishan hurried to pull him up and shoved a waterskin into his arms: “Drink. Drink. The phone, I'll go and make the call.”
strings.有人一把掀开了车斗上的帆布。: Someone yanked the canvas off the truck bed.
strings.有人哭了，有人笑了。至少，外面的人已经知道他们出事了。: Some cried, some laughed. At least, by now the outside world knew something had happened to them.
strings.有人想起来：雨刷器的水壶里还有两三升玻璃水，是夏天用的那种。有人说主要就是水和一: Someone remembered: there were still two or three liters of windshield washer fluid in the reservoir, the summer kind. Someone said it was mostly water and a little detergent; someone else said some brands cut it with methanol, and drinking it blinds you.
strings.有人托着 {protagonist} 的头，一瓶盖一瓶盖地往嘴里喂水。: Someone cradled {protagonist.his} head and fed {protagonist} water, one bottle cap at a time.
strings.有人把一瓶水塞进他手里，把他拖进了雅丹的阴影。他的手指动了动，没有睁眼。: Someone shoved a bottle of water into his hand and dragged him into the shade of a yardang. His fingers twitched; he did not open his eyes.
strings.有人把两只空水桶用绳子拴在一起，往它背上比了比——刚好能挂住。小骆驼喷了一下鼻子: Someone tied two empty buckets together with rope and held them against her back — they hung just right. The camel calf snorted once and did not shy away.
strings.有人把半截缰绳拴在了普拉多的保险杠上。小骆驼一口气喝光了半盆水，跪下来，卧进了车: Someone tied the half-rein to the Prado's bumper. The camel calf drank half a basin of water in one go, knelt, and settled into the shadow of the car.
strings.有人把最满的那几瓶水灌进了他的水袋。何川拍了拍水袋：“等到起。”: Someone poured the fullest bottles of water into his water bag. Chris Ho patted the bag: “Just wait.”
strings.有人把水瓶塞回老买手里：“喝。你还得给我们指路。”: Someone pushed the bottle back into Uncle Memet's hand: “Drink. You still have to show us the way.”
strings.有人指了指郑浩。郑浩张了张嘴，什么也没说出来。: Someone pointed at Howard Zheng. Howard Zheng opened his mouth and said nothing.
strings.有人用石子在沙地上摆了两个箭头：一个朝东，一个朝东北。: Someone laid two arrows out on the sand with stones: one pointing east, one northeast.
strings.有人解开了它鼻子上的断缰绳。小骆驼愣了一会儿，转身朝东边小跑着去了，蹄子在盐壳上: Someone untied the broken rein from her nose. The camel calf stood there a moment, then turned and trotted off east, her hooves leaving a clear line of prints on the salt crust.
strings.有人蹲下去，从他贴身的口袋里摸出了手机，屏幕上是一条从北边罗布泊镇过来的轨迹。走: Someone crouched down and fished the phone out of the pocket against his skin; on the screen was a track coming down from Lop Nur Town in the north. They walked a long way out, and nobody looked back.
strings.有人钻到陆地巡洋舰底下，拧开了放油螺丝。陆子昂站在一边，脸涨得通红，一句话也没说: Someone crawled under the Land Cruiser and opened the oil drain plug. Ryan Lu stood off to one side, face burning red, not saying a word.
strings.有轨迹，迷不了路；可这一走，就是把其他人扔下了: There's a track — you won't get lost; but walking out means leaving everyone else behind.
strings.来回二十多公里夜路；找到了就是三十升水，找不到可能还要搭进去一个人: Twenty-odd kilometers of night walking, round trip; find it and it's thirty liters of water; miss it and you might lose another person.
strings.棚子保住了，蒸馏坑和 SOS 顾不上: The shelter is saved; the stills and the SOS have to wait.
strings.棚子底下又安静了，只剩塑料布被风吹得啪啪响。: Under the shelter it went quiet again, with only the plastic sheeting snapping in the wind.
strings.水快见底了。普拉多的水箱里还有七八升绿莹莹的防冻液，闻着甜丝丝的。有人盯着它：“: The water was running out. There were still seven or eight liters of bright green antifreeze in the Prado's radiator, smelling faintly sweet. Someone stared at it: “Dilute it with water and drink it — better than dying of thirst, right?” Someone immediately snapped back: “That's ethylene glycol. One mouthful will kill you!”
strings.水是我的，可我也不能看着人渴死，对吧？对吧。: The water is mine, but I can't just watch a man die of thirst, right? Right.
strings.水比什么都金贵: Water is more precious than anything
strings.水浇上去，卡拉的肚皮一下一下地抽动。过了半个钟头，它摇摇晃晃地站起来，又钻回了车: The water splashed over him, and Kara's belly jerked again and again. Half an hour later he staggered to his feet and crawled back under the vehicle.
strings.水，省着喝……可是该喝的时候，要喝。人死了，水还在壶里——这样的事，我见过。: Water, ration it… but when it's time to drink, drink. A man dies and the water is still in the canteen — I've seen it.
strings.汉子抄起铁锹抡了一下，有人的胳膊被锹刃划开了一道口子，几个人才把他按住。: The man grabbed a shovel and swung it. Someone's arm was opened up by the blade, and it took several of them to hold him down.
strings.汉子骂了一句，自己回去刨了一夜。天亮前，皮卡的灯光往北边去了。他答应出去以后报警: The man cursed, then went back and dug all night himself. Before dawn, the pickup's lights headed north. He promised to call the police once he got out — nobody knows if he will.
strings.汉话里夹着维吾尔语，说话很慢。: His Chinese is mixed with Uyghur, and he speaks slowly.
strings.沉稳、倔、护着弱的；看不惯有钱人和吹牛的；信一条死理：人不能离开车。干活不惜力，: Steady, stubborn, protective of the weak; has no patience for rich men and braggarts; holds to one hard rule: a person does not leave the vehicle. Works without sparing himself and never complains.
strings.沉默、硬气，疼得厉害也不哼一声；清醒的时候说的话，比谁都管用。: Silent, tough; won't even grunt when the pain is bad. When he's lucid, what he says carries more weight than anyone else's words.
strings.沙地上一串碗口大的野骆驼脚印，朝东去了: A line of bowl-sized wild camel tracks in the sand, heading east
strings.沙海归来: Return from the Sea of Sand
strings.沙海无声: The Sea of Sand Is Silent
strings.沙漠求生第一条：留在车旁。两辆车比一个人醒目一百倍: Rule one of desert survival: stay with the vehicle. Two vehicles are a hundred times more visible than one man
strings.没人再提这件事。: No one brought it up again.
strings.没人再说什么。有人拿湿布给老买擦了擦裂开的嘴唇。: No one said anything more. Someone wiped Uncle Memet's cracked lips with a wet cloth.
strings.没有人动。卡拉的喘气声在车底下响了整整一个中午。: Nobody moved. Kara's panting went on under the vehicle all through noon.
strings.没有人回答他。大家只是抱着救援队递过来的水瓶，一口一口地喝。: Nobody answered him. They just held the water bottles the rescue team handed them and drank, sip by sip.
strings.河西口音，爱说“兄弟”“好说好说”“这个嘛，要看行情”。: Hexi accent, fond of “brother”, “no problem, no problem”, “well, that depends on the market”.
strings.活着出去，别让人烧了、拆了你爸的车: Get out alive, don't let them burn or strip your dad's vehicle
strings.活着出去，把存储卡里的素材带出去: Get out alive, bring the footage on the memory card out
strings.活还得有人干: Someone still has to do the work
strings.派人顺着脚印去找: Send men to follow the tracks
strings.派老韩和一个人开空车出去报信: Send Old Han and one other out in the empty Prado to raise the alarm
strings.浇上汽油点一条轮胎：白天冒起几百米高的黑烟，夜里是二三十公里外都看得见的一团火。: Soak a tire in gasoline and set it alight: by day it throws black smoke hundreds of meters high; at night it is a blaze visible from twenty or thirty kilometers away. Once the Prado's spare is gone, the only tires left to burn are off Ryan Lu's vehicle. With no tires left, only gasoline (5 L).
strings.淡蓝色的液体倒进了每个人的杯子里，有一股柠檬香精的味道。: The pale blue liquid was poured into everyone's cup. It smelled of lemon flavoring.
strings.深夜，东北方向的地平线上，两点车灯一闪一闪地移动，隔得太远，连声音都听不见。: Late at night, on the northeastern horizon, two headlights blink and crawl. They are too far away to hear at all.
strings.渴死和拉死，先别渴死: Thirst or the runs — don't die of thirst first
strings.湿沙上的蒸馏坑出水多得多；要用掉一块薄膜，夜里挖也得出一身汗: Distillation pits in wet sand yield far more water; it costs a sheet of plastic, and digging at night works up a sweat anyway
strings.灌 {protagonist} 喝郑浩那瓶白酒: Make {protagonist} drink Howard Zheng's bottle of baijiu
strings.火光最醒目，可轮胎烧一条少一条: Fire is the most visible, but every tire burned is one tire fewer
strings.火苗蹿起两层楼高，把周围的雅丹照得通红。几十公里外，也许有人正看着这团火。: The flames shot two stories high and lit the surrounding yardangs red. Tens of kilometers away, maybe someone is watching that fire.
strings.烧一条轮胎，用黑烟指路: Burn a tire, let the black smoke point the way
strings.照实说：骆驼让我们宰了，我们赔: Tell the truth: we killed the camel, we'll pay
strings.照着老买说的（或地图上画的）方向，夜里往东走十几公里，找那口地质队留下的苦水井。: Head east for a dozen or so kilometers at night, the way Uncle Memet says (or the way the map shows), to find the bitter-water well the survey team left behind. This is how Peng Jiamu walked into the desert and never came back. We can only set out at night.
strings.爬上营地边最高的雅丹，盯着地平线找扬尘和飞机，拿镜子朝四周反光；那上面偶尔能搜到: Climb the highest yardang by camp, watch the horizon for dust plumes and planes, and flash a mirror in all directions; up there you can sometimes catch one bar of cell signal. Only useful in daylight, and there is no shade at all on top.
strings.爬上雅丹守望: Climb the yardang and keep watch
strings.牧民丢了骆驼会一直找；可它一天要喝掉快两个人的水: Herders look for a lost camel forever; but she drinks nearly as much water a day as two people
strings.狗也是一条命；可这一升半水，够一个人撑小半天: The dog is a life too; but this liter and a half would keep a man going half a day
strings.独自徒步罗布泊的背包客: A backpacker crossing Lop Nur alone
strings.现在撕破脸，对谁都没好处: Falling out now does nobody any good
strings.现在是被困后的第一个早晨。车上还有八十来升水、一些馕和零食、两车剩下的汽油、几条: It is the first morning after being stranded. There is still about eighty liters of water aboard, some naan and snacks, the gasoline left in both vehicles, several tires, and a large sheet of plastic. The nearest paved road is eighty kilometers away. At noon the temperature climbs to forty-five degrees or so, and the salt crust is hot enough to bake flatbread on — and outside, nobody knows you are in trouble yet.
strings.现在谁有力气吵这个: Who has the strength to argue about this now?
strings.玻璃水被分着倒进了几个蒸馏坑的坑底。: The washer fluid was shared out and poured into the bottoms of several distillation pits.
strings.理想主义，倔，看不起开车进罗布泊的人；对沙漠有一套自己的纪律：白天不动、夜里赶路: An idealist, stubborn, with contempt for the people who drive into Lop Nur; he has his own discipline for the desert: don't move by day, travel by night, watch the color of your urine. Being rescued sits badly with him, and his tongue is sharp, but he never spares himself when there is work.
strings.甘肃口音，说话慢，爱说“娃娃”“莫慌”“沙漠里头急不得”。: Gansu accent, speaks slowly, fond of “kid”, “no rush”, “out in the desert there's no hurrying”.
strings.用帐篷杆和塑料布做副担架，抬着老买一起走: Build a stretcher from tent poles and plastic sheeting and carry Uncle Memet along
strings.用水把人全身浇透，拼命扇风: Douse the man head to toe with water and fan him hard
strings.用石块、黑色的座椅垫和车轮印，在白花花的盐壳上摆出几十米长的 SOS 和箭头。从: Use rocks, black seat cushions and wheel tracks to lay out a SOS and an arrow tens of meters long on the glaring salt crust. From the air it stands out sharply, but wind and sand will slowly smooth it away. Doing it by day costs two or three extra liters of sweat; by night, about a liter and a half.
strings.电话响了一声就断了，再也拨不出去。: The call rang once and cut off; it would not go through again.
strings.电话通了十几秒。{actor} 对着话筒喊：“罗布泊湖心东北，雅丹，六个人！”对: The call connected for a dozen seconds. {actor} shouted into the handset: “Northeast of the center of Lop Nur, yardangs, six people!” The other end said “Received,” and the line went dead.
strings.画面的尽头，一条淡淡的灰线横穿过盐壳——是车压出来的路！: At the edge of the frame, a faint gray line cut across the salt crust — a track worn by tires!
strings.留在车旁，等人来找: Stay with the vehicle and wait to be found
strings.瘤胃里能拧出几升发绿的汁水，肉能晒成干；可那是别人家的骆驼，吃肉也要耗水: You can wring several liters of greenish fluid out of the rumen, and the meat can be dried; but that camel belongs to someone else, and eating meat burns water too
strings.白天，躺着；晚上，走路。沙漠里头，骆驼都知道。: By day, lie still; by night, walk. Out in the desert, even the camels know that.
strings.皮卡在半路陷进了一片虚土，大家推了半夜才推出来。葛长贵说什么也不肯再拉这么多人，: Halfway along, the pickup sank into a stretch of soft dust, and it took half the night of pushing to get it out. Gary Ge flatly refused to carry that many people any further; swearing, he drove off alone and left the whole group standing on the ruts back to camp.
strings.皮卡开出去不到十公里，一头扎进虚土，后桥的半轴断了。被反绑在车斗里的葛长贵笑了起: Less than ten kilometers out, the pickup plunged into soft dust and snapped a rear axle shaft. Gary Ge, his hands tied behind him in the truck bed, burst out laughing until he coughed. They had no choice but to shoulder the water, escort him along, and follow the ruts back to camp.
strings.皮卡的尾灯在雅丹之间晃了几下，往北边去了。: The pickup's taillights wobbled between the yardangs and headed north.
strings.盐壳上的 SOS、车辙和两辆车本身。风沙会把它们抹平。: The SOS on the salt crust, the wheel tracks, and the two vehicles themselves. Wind and sand will smooth them away.
strings.盐壳上闪起了一片光点。: A spread of bright points flashed across the salt crust.
strings.盖蒸馏坑的薄膜用完了。唯一剩下的大块塑料布正撑在头顶上遮阳。有人算了算：剪下一半: The sheeting covering the distillation pits ran out. The only big piece of plastic left is stretched overhead for shade. Someone did the math: cut it in half and we can still dig three more pits.
strings.相信他，记下他说的方向: Trust him, write down the direction he gives
strings.看尿的颜色：像茶还行，像酱油就要出事了。: Watch the color of your urine: like tea is all right, like soy sauce means trouble.
strings.真到了要渴死的时候，也许……: If it really comes to dying of thirst, maybe…
strings.短信一直在转圈，最后跳出一个红色的感叹号。: The message kept spinning, then a red exclamation mark popped up.
strings.短信比电话更容易发出去: A text message gets through more easily than a call
strings.第三天早上，钾盐厂一辆拉货的重卡在便道上急刹：一个瘦得脱了相的年轻人从沙梁后面扑: On the third morning, a freight truck from the potash plant braked hard on the haul road: a young man, gaunt past recognition, burst out from behind a sand ridge, lips too cracked to speak, a cigarette-pack wrapper clutched in his hand with the camp's position drawn on it in ballpoint. It was Chris Ho. The search convoy followed that wrapper into the yardangs. Those who made it: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see it: {dead}.
strings.第九天上午，一架搜救直升机在雅丹群上空发现了那两辆车。活着被抬上飞机的人是：{s: On the morning of the ninth day, a search helicopter flying over the yardangs spotted the two vehicles. Those lifted onto the aircraft alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see this day: {dead}.
strings.第二天早上，{actor} 和陆子昂谁也没提昨晚的事。: The next morning, neither {actor} nor Ryan Lu mentioned the night before.
strings.第二天早上，{actor} 说她在沟底的沙子里捡到了一台 GPS。: The next morning, {actor} said {actor.he} had picked up a GPS in the sand at the bottom of the gully.
strings.第二天早上，有人在老买的帆布包里“找到”了那台 GPS。: The next morning, someone “found” that GPS in Uncle Memet's canvas bag.
strings.第二天早上，还是没有信号，也没有人来。有人说：“等下去就是等死，今晚得有人走出去: The next morning there was still no signal, and no one came. Someone said: “Waiting here is waiting to die. Tonight someone has to walk out.” Immediately someone shook his head: “Out in the desert, a man away from the vehicle is a grain of sand. Nobody will ever find him.”
strings.第二天私下找他：分我一份，我就不说: Go to him privately the next day: give me a share and I'll say nothing
strings.第二天，有人喝了蒸馏坑里的水以后头晕、呕吐——薄膜上溅进了几滴没蒸过的防冻液。: On the second day, someone drank from a distillation pit and came down dizzy and vomiting — a few drops of undiluted antifreeze had splashed onto the sheeting.
strings.第二天，老韩拖着步子走回了营地：车在三十公里外陷死了，水箱又开了锅。: On the second day, Old Han dragged himself back to camp: the vehicle was bogged fast thirty kilometers out, and the radiator had boiled over again.
strings.答应他：老买和另一个人先走，天黑出发: Agree with him: Uncle Memet and one other go first, setting out at nightfall
strings.精明、油滑、能吃苦；对人客客气气，眼睛却一直在算账。最怕警察和巡护队。心不算太黑: Shrewd, slippery, able to take hardship; polite to your face while his eyes keep running the numbers. What he fears most is the police and the patrols. He isn't all black-hearted — faced with a man dying in front of him, he couldn't finish him off; but pushed to the wall, he looks after himself first.
strings.红色的录制灯一闪一闪。陆子昂抬起头，看见了镜头。: The red recording light blinked on and off. Ryan Lu looked up and saw the camera.
strings.给他八升水，让他走: Give him eight liters of water and let him go
strings.给他留一瓶水，扶到背阴处，傍晚再来看: Leave him a bottle of water, move him into the shade, and check on him toward evening
strings.给她一个自己开口的机会: Give her a chance to speak for herself
strings.给它驮上两桶水，今晚派人牵着它往东北走: Load two barrels of water on her and send someone to lead her northeast tonight
strings.绿色的液体渗进盐壳里，留下一圈甜腻的味道。: The green liquid seeped into the salt crust, leaving a ring of sickly sweet smell.
strings.编一条短信，写清位置，发给家里: Compose a text message, write down the position clearly, send it home
strings.罗布泊一年也下不了几场雨。闷雷滚过盐壳，豆大的雨点砸下来。: It rains only a few times a year in Lop Nur. Muffled thunder rolled over the salt crust and fat raindrops pelted down.
strings.罗布泊核心区早就禁止私自穿越。你在报备系统和发给家属的行程单上，填的是一百多公里: Crossing the core zone of Lop Nur on your own has long been forbidden. On the filing system and the itinerary sent to your families, you wrote the legal route on the Hami–Lop Nur Highway, more than a hundred kilometers away. Even if a search starts outside, it will look in the wrong place first.
strings.罗布泊的盐壳里不光有盐，还有芒硝和石膏: The salt crust of Lop Nur holds not only salt, but also mirabilite and gypsum
strings.罗布泊，以前是海子。我爷爷那时候，划着卡盆打鱼……现在，只有盐了。: Lop Nur used to be a lake. In my grandfather's day, he paddled a kapen and fished… now there is only salt.
strings.翻两辆车和行李: Search both vehicles and the luggage
strings.翻他的口袋找药，扶他躺平: Go through his pockets for medicine, lay him flat
strings.翻得满头大汗，什么也没找到: Searched until sweat poured down his face and found nothing
strings.翻车后你第一个爬进那辆普拉多，从昏迷的老向导兜里摸走了他的手持 GPS——里面存: After the crash you were the first to crawl into that Prado and slip the handheld GPS out of the unconscious old guide's pocket — it holds the track you came in on, and one bar of battery is left. You told no one: you were afraid they would take it and leave you behind.
strings.老买从米兰镇带来的狗，黑毛、细腿、尖耳朵，“卡拉”在维吾尔语里就是“黑”。它跟着: Uncle Memet's dog, brought from Milan Township: black coat, thin legs, pointed ears — “Kara” means “black” in Uyghur. He has crossed the desert with Uncle Memet several times, digs his own pits to escape the heat, and goes out at night to catch sand rats. Since the crash he has stayed at Uncle Memet's side, and no one can drive him away.
strings.老买和老韩会记住这件事: Uncle Memet and Old Han will remember this
strings.老买在若羌县医院躺了两个月。出院那天，他让儿子开车送他到米兰镇东头的戈壁边上，朝: Uncle Memet lay in Ruoqiang County Hospital for two months. The day he was discharged, he had his son drive him to the edge of the gobi at the east end of Milan Township, and stood a long time facing the direction of Lop Nur. He said it was the old Loplik rule: come back alive from the desert, and you bow your head to the sand.
strings.老买把自己那瓶水推了回来，转过头去，看着东边。: Uncle Memet pushed his own bottle of water back, turned his head away, and looked east.
strings.老买拉住身边人的手，嘴唇裂得说不清话：“我的那份水……给娃娃们喝吧。我这把骨头，: Uncle Memet gripped the hand of the person beside him, his lips so cracked he could barely speak: “My share of the water… give it to the kids. These old bones of mine aren't getting out.”
strings.老买挣扎着撑起半个身子，要人把骆驼的头朝西摆正，念了一句“比斯米拉”，才让人下刀: Uncle Memet struggled up onto one elbow and had them turn the camel's head toward the west. He murmured “Bismillah,” and only then let them use the knife.
strings.老买没能出来。老韩出院以后，一个人开车去了米兰镇，把老买的帆布包交给了他的儿子。: Uncle Memet never came out. After Old Han was discharged from the hospital, he drove to Milan Township alone and handed Uncle Memet's canvas bag to his son. The hand-drawn map inside, the well circled in red ink — Old Han went back to search for it once more. He found the well. The water was bitter.
strings.老买没能回家。卡拉被老买的小儿子接回了米兰镇，可它在院子里待不住，隔几天就一个人: Uncle Memet never came home. Kara was taken back to Milan Township by Uncle Memet's youngest son, but the dog would not stay in the yard. Every few days he slipped off alone to the edge of the gobi east of town and sat facing the direction of Lop Nur for a whole afternoon. Everyone in town knew the black dog, and nobody shooed him away.
strings.老买的帆布包：一张手绘的老地图，上面用红笔圈着一口井: Uncle Memet's canvas bag: an old hand-drawn map with a well circled in red ink
strings.老买的狗，一条黑色的南疆土狗: Uncle Memet's dog, a black southern Xinjiang mongrel
strings.老买的骨盆打了钢板，走路要拄拐，再也没给人当过向导。每年秋天，老韩都会从甘肃寄来: Uncle Memet's pelvis was plated with steel, he walked with a cane, and he never guided anyone again. Every autumn Old Han mailed a crate of apples from Gansu, with a note tucked inside in crooked handwriting: “Uncle Memet, don't go into the desert.”
strings.老买被抬进了驾驶室，卡在座位和车门之间，疼得一声没吭。: Uncle Memet was lifted into the cab and wedged between the seat and the door, in agony, and never made a sound.
strings.老买被葬在米兰镇的麻扎里。下葬那天来了很多罗布人，也来了几个他年轻时带过的科考队: Uncle Memet was buried in the mazar at Milan Township. Many Loplik came to the funeral, along with a few members of the survey teams he had guided when he was young, their hair white now. Someone said he was the one who had first led a geological team to that bitter well in Lop Nur.
strings.老买醒了一会儿，手一直在自己的上衣口袋里摸：“我的 GPS 呢……那里头有来的路: Uncle Memet woke for a moment, his hand groping at his jacket pocket: “Where's my GPS… the way back is in there…” Then his clouded eyes turned and landed on {actor}.
strings.老向导，罗布人的后代: Old guide, descendant of the Loplik
strings.老韩把存储卡用塑料袋包了三层，揣进了胸前的口袋。: Old Han wrapped the memory card in three layers of plastic bag and tucked it into his breast pocket.
strings.老韩把水壶挂在后视镜上，发动机的声音渐渐消失在东北方向。: Old Han hung the canteen on the rearview mirror, and the sound of the engine faded away to the northeast.
strings.老韩把老买送回了米兰镇，在老买家的土炕上住了一个礼拜。两个人每天坐在院子里的桑树: Old Han drove Uncle Memet back to Milan Township and stayed a week on the earthen kang at Uncle Memet's house. Every day the two of them sat under the mulberry tree in the yard drinking tea, and neither of them mentioned Lop Nur. When he left, Uncle Memet stuffed a naan into his bag: “That heart of yours — don't go into the desert again.” Old Han said, “I won't.”
strings.老韩接过 GPS，翻过来看了看背面刻着的维吾尔文名字，又看了唐小禾很久。: Old Han took the GPS, turned it over to look at the Uyghur name engraved on the back, and then looked at Holly Tang for a long moment.
strings.老韩摆摆手，靠在车轮上，闭着眼睛大口喘气。: Old Han waved a hand, leaned back against the wheel, and gasped for breath with his eyes closed.
strings.老韩是一个人消失在沙海里的。南疆线上的老司机们自发凑了一个车队，在雅丹群里找了半: Old Han vanished into the sea of sand alone. The veteran drivers on the southern Xinjiang routes put together a search convoy on their own and combed the yardangs for half a month, and in the end they found his cap at the bottom of a gully, with the little nitroglycerin bottle stuffed under the brim. It was empty.
strings.老韩是被硬塞进那辆破皮卡的——大家都看得出来，他的心脏撑不住了。到了钾盐厂的医务: Old Han had to be shoved into that beat-up pickup — everyone could see his heart was giving out. At the potash plant infirmary, the first thing he said, gripping the doctor's hand, was: “There are still people at the camp. And an old man with a hurt back.”
strings.老韩正弯着腰干活，忽然捂住胸口跪了下去。他脸色灰得吓人，满头冷汗，左胳膊一直在抖: Old Han was bent over working when he suddenly clutched his chest and dropped to his knees. His face was a frightening gray, cold sweat all over his forehead, his left arm shaking, and he was still saying: “No rush, no rush…”
strings.老韩死在了他跑了一辈子的戈壁边上。南疆线上的老司机们凑钱给他立了一块碑，碑上刻着: Old Han died at the edge of the gobi he had driven his whole life. The veteran drivers of the southern Xinjiang routes pooled money for a stone marker, carved with the line he always said: “In the desert, you can't hurry.”
strings.老韩的心脏最后还是没撑住。他的老伴直到看见死亡证明，才知道他三年前搭过两个支架，: In the end Old Han's heart gave out anyway. His wife learned only when she saw the death certificate that he had had two stents put in three years earlier, and that he had gone to Lop Nur to “earn money to pay off debts.” On the phone she said only: “That dead old man.” Then she cried for a long time.
strings.老韩看见了 {actor} 往老买包里塞东西的那只手，什么也没说。: Old Han saw the hand {actor} used to slip something into Uncle Memet's bag, and said nothing.
strings.聪明、谨慎、胆小；书本知识很多——太阳能蒸馏、看星星辨方向——却从没在野外吃过苦: Clever, cautious, timid; strong on book learning — solar distillation, navigating by the stars — but has never known hardship outdoors. Cornered, will do something selfish, then feel guilty about it for a long time.
strings.胆小又倔；饿了什么都啃，连塑料布都啃。有人靠近就喷鼻子、吐口水，夜里一直朝着东边: Skittish and stubborn; when hungry she will chew anything, even plastic sheeting. If anyone comes near she snorts and spits, and all night she cries toward the east, as if calling for her mother.
strings.能保住东西，出去的人可能被吹伤: Keeps the gear safe; whoever goes out may get sandblasted
strings.能动的人都去帮他挖车: Everyone who can move helps dig out the vehicle
strings.能接得最多，遮阳棚得重新搭: Catches the most rain, but the sunshade has to be put up again
strings.能说会道、好面子、习惯拍胸脯打包票；出了事第一反应是怎么撇清责任，但真到要命的关: A smooth talker who cares about face and is always thumping his chest with big promises; when trouble hits, his first instinct is to dodge the blame, but when it truly turns deadly he will step up. What he fears most is someone dying.
strings.脚印到一片硬盐壳上就断了。找的人在太阳底下喊到嗓子哑，只好回来。: The footprints stopped at a stretch of hard salt crust. The searchers shouted themselves hoarse in the sun and had to turn back.
strings.脱水按占体重的百分比算：超过 6% 开始伤身，超过 15% 致命。脱水越重，身体: Dehydration is measured as a percentage of body weight: past 6% it starts damaging the body, past 15% it kills. The worse the dehydration, the less heat the body can shed, and the more easily core temperature surges past 39–40°C (heat exhaustion, heatstroke). In people who weigh less, the percentage climbs faster.
strings.艾山摸着小骆驼的脖子，用维吾尔语念叨了半天，又转过头来，用生硬的汉话说：“人，先: Aishan stroked the camel calf's neck and muttered in Uyghur for a long time, then turned and said in halting Chinese: “People, drink water first. The phone, I go and make the call.”
strings.艾山看着车门上晒着的肉条，沉默了很久，最后摆了摆手：“骆驼，是钱的事。人，是命的: Aishan looked at the strips of meat drying on the car door and was silent for a long time. At last he waved a hand: “The camel, that is a matter of money. A person, that is a matter of life.” He pushed the waterskin over.
strings.艾山蹲下去，翻了翻扔在沟里的骆驼骨头，骨头上有刀口。他站起来，什么也没说，还是把: Aishan crouched and turned over the camel bones thrown in the gully; there were knife marks on them. He stood up, said nothing, and still pushed the waterskin over.
strings.苏芮会恨投赞成票的人: Ruby Su will hate whoever voted yes
strings.苏芮把存储卡塞进了内衣的夹层里。: Ruby Su slipped the memory card into the lining of her bra.
strings.苏芮把整件事都剪进了片子，包括卫星电话从她手里滑落的那三秒。片子播出以后，骂她的: Ruby Su cut the whole thing into her film, including the three seconds when the satellite phone slipped from her hand. After it aired, the people cursing her were as many as those who ached for her. She turned off comments, switched to another account, and from then on filmed only other people.
strings.苏芮是一个人消失在沙海里的。她的相机后来被一支科考队在三十公里外捡到，存储卡里最: Ruby Su vanished into the sea of sand alone. Her camera was later picked up by a survey team thirty kilometers away, and the last video on the memory card held only wind and her breathing, the lens fixed on the horizon. Nobody has ever made that video public.
strings.苏芮是坐着那辆破皮卡先走的人。她在车上一直举着相机，拍下了葛长贵抽烟的侧脸和车斗: Ruby Su was the one who left first in that beat-up pickup. She held her camera up the whole way, filming Gary Ge's profile as he smoked and the canvas tarp over the truck bed. She never released that footage — she said that when someone saves your life, you cannot cut them into a film.
strings.苏芮的相机是在她身边找到的，存储卡还插在里面。最后一段素材是夜里拍的星空，镜头晃: Ruby Su's camera was found beside her, the memory card still in it. The last clip was of the night sky; the frame shook once and her voice came through: “Today is day…” The rest was covered by the wind. Her eight hundred thousand followers waited three months, and what arrived was an obituary.
strings.苏芮的纪录片《沙海》在网上播了三千万次，最后一个镜头是盐壳上被风吹淡的 SOS。: Ruby Su's documentary “Sea of Sand” was watched thirty million times online. Its final shot was an SOS on the salt crust, fading in the wind. She donated half the revenue to the Ruoqiang County rescue team. The three seconds when the satellite phone slipped from her hand she never once cut in.
strings.若羌县米兰镇人，年轻时给石油勘探队和科考队当过向导，大家都叫他“老买”。翻车时被: A native of Milan Township, Ruoqiang County. In his youth he guided oil exploration crews and survey teams, and everyone called him “Uncle Memet.” Thrown from the vehicle in the rollover, pelvis fractured, a gash opened on his head; he drifts in and out of sleep.
strings.苦水井里背回来的水又苦又咸，喝下去嗓子发涩。有人开始拉肚子，越拉越渴。: The water carried back from the bitter well is bitter and salty, and it leaves the throat raw. Someone has started having diarrhea, and the more it runs, the thirstier everyone gets.
strings.苦水只倒进蒸馏坑里蒸: Bitter water goes only into the distillation pit
strings.莫得事，四百多公里我都走过来了，还差这几十公里？: Ain't no problem. I walked over four hundred kilometers to get here — what's another few dozen kilometers?
strings.营地少搭一点；他路上就多一分险: The camp gives up a little less; a little more danger for him on the road
strings.葛长贵一把扯回帆布：“谁也别碰我的车！”他再也不提报警的事了。: Gary Ge yanked the canvas back: “Nobody touches my truck!” He never mentioned calling the police again.
strings.葛长贵发动了皮卡，从车窗里扔出来一包烟，往北边开走了。: Gary Ge started the pickup, threw a pack of cigarettes out the window, and drove off north.
strings.葛长贵愣了一下，咧嘴笑了：“行，兄弟，你们讲究。”: Gary Ge blinked, then grinned: “All right, brothers. You play it straight.”
strings.葛长贵抡起铁锹砸翻了扑上来的人，拎起营地边上的两桶水扔进车斗，跳上驾驶室，一脚油: Gary Ge swung the shovel and knocked down the man who lunged at him, grabbed the two water drums at the edge of camp and heaved them into the truck bed, jumped into the cab, and floored it.
strings.葛长贵报警的回合: The round where Gary Ge calls the police
strings.葛长贵掐灭了烟：“行，天黑走。白天开车，巡护队的飞机看得见。”: Gary Ge stubbed out his cigarette: “Fine, we leave after dark. Driving in daylight, the patrol planes can see us.”
strings.葛长贵最后是被警察带走的。车斗里那三袋东西让案子一下子变了性质：几百枚五铢钱、一: In the end the police took Gary Ge away. The three sacks in the truck bed changed the whole nature of the case: several hundred wuzhu coins, a bag of bronze arrowheads, and a wooden coffin panel painted with red and black cloud patterns. He was sentenced to nine years. On the day of the hearing he nodded from a distance to a few people in the gallery, and no one could say whether it was hatred or thanks.
strings.葛长贵答应出去以后报警；如果他真的报了，从这一回合起外面才知道你们的位置。: Gary Ge has agreed to call the police once he gets out; if he really does, this is the round when the outside world first learns your position.
strings.蒸出来的是淡水，可蒸馏坑出水太慢: What comes out is fresh water, but the distillation pit yields too slowly
strings.蒸馏坑能多出一些水: The distillation pit yields a little more water
strings.表层的沙子烫手，往下刨二十公分就凉了。卡拉趴进坑里，把肚皮贴在凉沙上，喘得慢了一: The surface sand burns your hand; dig down twenty centimeters and it is cool. Kara crawled into the hole and pressed his belly to the cool sand, and his panting slowed.
strings.被困后的第一个早晨。太阳刚冒头，盐壳就开始发烫，老买躺在普拉多的阴影里哼哼，卡拉: The first morning after being stranded. The sun has barely risen and the salt crust is already heating up. Uncle Memet lies groaning in the Prado's shadow, Kara sprawled at his feet with his tongue out. Eighty-odd liters of water are stacked by the vehicle. While the morning is still cool, what do you do first?
strings.被宠坏了，怕吃苦，嘴硬心虚；习惯用钱摆平一切；真吓坏了会崩溃大哭。对那辆车比对人: Spoiled, afraid of hardship, tough talk and a timid heart; used to settling everything with money; when truly terrified, breaks down sobbing. Cares more about that vehicle than about people.
strings.西北边的天上立起一堵黄褐色的墙，转眼就压到了头顶。沙子打在脸上像针扎，遮阳棚被风: A wall of yellow-brown stood up in the northwestern sky and was overhead in the blink of an eye. Sand stung their faces like needles, the sunshade cracked and snapped in the wind — a sandstorm!
strings.西边滚过一阵闷雷，天一下子黑了。豆大的雨点砸在盐壳上，砸出一个个小坑——下雨了！: A low roll of thunder came from the west and the sky went black at once. Raindrops the size of beans hammered the salt crust, pocking it with little craters — it's raining!
strings.要 15 升汽油。车轻，不容易陷；剩下的人在原地等: Needs 15 liters of gasoline. A light vehicle won't bog easily; the rest of you wait here
strings.要 25 升汽油。车越重越容易陷，陷死了就再也没有退路: Needs 25 liters of gasoline. The heavier the vehicle, the more easily it bogs; bog down for good and there is no way back
strings.要去也得结伴，天亮前必须回来: If anyone goes, they go in pairs, and must be back before dawn
strings.要用掉 2 升水，也不一定管用: Uses 2 liters of water, and may not even work
strings.要用掉三升水，抬人的几个也得出一身汗；以后营地里就多了一张嘴: Uses three liters of water, and the ones carrying him will sweat through their clothes; from then on there is one more mouth at camp
strings.让他自己去：找到拉车，就接着往钾盐厂的便道走，去报信: Send him alone: if he finds his handcart, he keeps going to the potash haul road to raise the alarm
strings.让他自己挖。只求他出去以后替我们报个警: Let him dig himself out. All we ask is that he calls the police for us once he is out
strings.让他自己缓一缓: Give him time to recover on his own
strings.让唐小禾拿地质图对照一下: Have Holly Tang check it against the geological map
strings.让天上的人能看见。干完活每个人都会出一身汗: Make it visible from the air. When the work is done everyone will be soaked in sweat
strings.让老买活着离开罗布泊: Get Uncle Memet out of Lop Nur alive
strings.让苏芮的无人机往东北飞七八公里，从几百米高的地方看路、找井、找大车。一块电池只能: Fly Ruby Su's drone seven or eight kilometers northeast to look for a road, a well, or a truck from a few hundred meters up. One battery lasts only twenty-odd minutes. It can only fly in daylight.
strings.记住这个位置，换个时候再来试: Remember this spot and come back to try again another time
strings.该谁负责就谁负责: Whoever is responsible answers for it
strings.说不定底下就是水；也说不定是别的东西: Maybe there is water down there; then again, maybe it is something else
strings.说话利落，带点播音腔；紧张的时候会对着镜头自言自语地“口播”。: Talks fast and crisp, with a bit of broadcaster polish; when nervous, delivers a running commentary to the camera, talking to herself.
strings.说骆驼是自己渴死的: Say the camel died of thirst on its own
strings.谁也不扔下。可抬着人走，一夜走不了多远: Nobody gets left behind. But carrying a man, you won't get far in one night
strings.谁也不欠谁；他会不会报警，看他的良心: Nobody owes anybody; whether he calls the police is up to his conscience
strings.谁也不许私自喝。搬东西的时候，也许会翻出点别的: Nobody drinks on the sly. While moving the gear, you might turn up something else
strings.谁也别出去，等天黑再说: Nobody goes out. Wait for dark.
strings.走。给老买留下水，天亮就带人回来接他: Go. Leave water for Uncle Memet; come back for him with help at dawn.
strings.走开，离它远一点: Get away. Stay clear of it.
strings.趁他说话的工夫，有人摸进皮卡的驾驶室，拔下了钥匙。汉子愣了一下，脸色变得很难看：: While he was talking, someone slipped into the pickup's cab and pulled the keys. The man froze, his face turning ugly: “Fine, fine. You people are ruthless.” Everyone had helped dig that truck out, but the keys stayed in someone else's fist. He said his name was Gary Ge, from Dunhuang, delivering spare parts to the potash plant.
strings.趁凉快，先在盐壳上摆一个大大的 SOS: While it is cool, lay out a big SOS on the salt crust
strings.趁夜里凉快，带上水和手电往东北走大半夜，找那条拉钾盐的大车路，天亮前回来。方向感: While the night is cool, take water and a flashlight and walk northeast for most of the night to find the big potash haul road, and be back before dawn. The better your sense of direction, the more you find; get lost and, once the sun is up, you are in danger. You can only set out at night.
strings.趁所有人都缩在棚子底下打盹，葛长贵发动了皮卡。等有人追出去，车已经开出了一里地—: While everyone was dozing under the awning, Gary Ge started the pickup. By the time anyone ran out after him, the truck was already half a kilometer away — and the camp's water drums were much lighter.
strings.趁没人注意，悄悄塞回他的包里: While no one is looking, quietly slip it back into his bag
strings.越抽越喝，越喝越抽: The more you smoke, the more you drink; the more you drink, the more you smoke
strings.越野俱乐部老板，这次穿越的领队: Owner of an off-road club, leader of this crossing
strings.车主已经不在了，没人再拦着：大家把陆地巡洋舰的电瓶和机油拆了过来。: The owner was gone now, and no one stopped them anymore: they pulled the battery and drained the oil from the Land Cruiser and carried them over.
strings.车斗里塞得下所有人——就看他肯不肯: The truck bed can hold everyone — if he is willing
strings.车熄了火，停在沟边。: The engine died, and the vehicle stopped at the edge of the gully.
strings.车窗外一片昏黄，沙子打在铁皮上沙沙地响了一整天。: Outside the windows all was brown murk, and sand hissed against the sheet metal all day long.
strings.车门被拽开的一瞬间，陆子昂手里的红牛洒了一裤子。后备箱地板下面的暗格还敞着。: The instant the door was yanked open, the Red Bull in Ryan Lu's hand spilled all over his pants. The hidden compartment under the trunk floor was still open.
strings.车顶行李架上一个没摔漏的副油桶: A spare fuel can on the roof rack that did not spring a leak
strings.转了半个小时，短信终于显示“已送达”。{actor} 坐在雅丹顶上，捂着脸哭了。: After half an hour of trying, the message finally showed “Delivered.” {actor} sat on top of a yardang, face in {actor.his} hands, and cried.
strings.轮胎烧了一个多小时，那两点光始终没有转向，慢慢消失了。: The tires burned for over an hour, and those two points of light never once turned toward them before they slowly disappeared.
strings.还在出水的太阳能蒸馏坑。: A solar still that is still giving water.
strings.这一回合烧轮胎、镜子反光发出的信号，回合结束清零。: Any signal sent this round by burning tires or mirror flashes resets to zero when the round ends.
strings.这件事又被搁下了。: And so the matter was shelved again.
strings.这会是整部片子最有力的镜头: This will be the most powerful shot in the whole film
strings.这片雅丹我跑了七年，闭着眼睛都摸得出去——前提是车能动。: I have run these yardangs for seven years; I could find my way out with my eyes closed — as long as the vehicle can move.
strings.远处扬起一道长长的烟尘——几辆插着红旗的越野车，后面跟着一辆救护车，正朝营地开过: A long plume of dust rose in the distance — several off-road vehicles flying red flags, with an ambulance behind them, driving straight at the camp! Before they had even stopped, a man in uniform jumped down and shouted: “How many are still alive? Who is the leader?”
strings.迷失在沙海: Lost in the Sea of Sand
strings.退休的老卡车司机，车队请来压阵: A retired long-haul trucker, brought along to steady the convoy
strings.通了就能说清楚，可信号太弱: Once it connects, everything can be explained — but the signal's too weak
strings.逼郑浩说清楚：报备的到底是哪条路: Make Howard Zheng come clean: which route did he file?
strings.遮阳棚会差很多，白天休息的人要多出汗: The sunshade will be much worse — anyone resting by day sweats more
strings.那一夜，葛长贵的破皮卡载着所有人冲出了雅丹。车斗里的人挤成一团，谁也没说话，只有: That night, Gary Ge's beat-up pickup carried them all out of the yardangs. In the truck bed they were packed into one heap; nobody spoke, only those three woven sacks rattling underfoot. By dawn the headlights caught the barrier at the potash plant checkpoint. Survivors: {survivors}. Later, the police taking statements kept asking: that truck — borrowed, or stolen? No one who had ridden in it could answer.
strings.那两点车灯停住了，接着闪了三下——他们看见了！: The two headlights stopped, then flashed three times — they've seen us!
strings.那半桶绿色的液体被放在了车后面的阴影里。: The half bucket of green liquid was set down in the shade behind the vehicle.
strings.那口井值得去找。待在这里也是等死: That well is worth finding. Staying here is waiting to die
strings.那台陆地巡洋舰最后被拆得只剩一个空壳，留在了雅丹沟边。陆子昂回北京以后挨了他爸一: The Land Cruiser was eventually stripped down to an empty shell and left beside the yardang gully. Back in Beijing, Ryan Lu took a slap from his father, and then the two of them sat in the living room all night without turning on a light. The next year he sold every car he owned and gave the money to Ruoqiang County's desert rescue team.
strings.那壶玻璃水留在了车里。: The jug of washer fluid stayed in the vehicle.
strings.那天夜里，葛长贵把人送到了钾盐厂医务室的门口，没等人道谢就掉头开走了。后来有人按: That night Gary Ge dropped them at the potash plant infirmary door and drove off before anyone could thank him. Later people went looking under the name he gave; in Dunhuang there was no such driver hauling parts to the potash plant. The plate was fake, and the name likely fake too. Only those who got out of that truck remember that he never said a word the whole way, just smoked one cigarette after another.
strings.那是海市蜃楼，躺回阴凉里: That's a mirage — lie back down in the shade
strings.那辆皮卡开走以后，营地里的人又等了很久。坐着它先走的人活了下来；留下的人里，有的: After the pickup drove off, the camp waited a long time. Those who rode out first survived; of those left behind, some did not live long enough to be found. Afterwards nobody spoke of how the choice was made that night — while it was being made, no one dared meet the eyes of the ones staying. Survivors: {survivors}. Those who didn't make it: {dead}.
strings.郑浩一脚踢翻了水桶——空的。他蹲下去，抱住了头。: Howard Zheng kicked over the water bucket — empty. He crouched down and clutched his head.
strings.郑浩是一个人消失在沙海里的。搜救队顺着他的脚印找了三天，脚印在一片硬盐壳上断了。: Howard Zheng vanished into the sea of sand alone. The search team followed his tracks for three days; the trail broke off on a stretch of hard salt crust. His name is still on the missing-persons list at the Ruoqiang County Public Security Bureau, with the photo from the club brochure: sunglasses, shell jacket, thumbs up.
strings.郑浩是坐着那辆破皮卡先走的人。到了钾盐厂，他做的第一件事是借电话报警，第二件事是: Howard Zheng was one of those who rode out first in that beat-up pickup. At the potash plant, the first thing he did was borrow a phone and call the police; the second was find himself a lawyer. Later, whenever he told people about Lop Nur, he always started with “that night I risked my life to get out and raise the alarm” — and not one listener ever called him on it.
strings.郑浩死在了沙海里。他改过的那张行程单后来被翻了出来，家属们在法庭上一张一张地念。: Howard Zheng died in the sea of sand. The itinerary he had altered was later dug out, and the families read it aloud in court, page by page. In the defendants' seat sat another partner from the club — after Howard Zheng's name there was only “deceased; no action taken”.
strings.郑浩没能走出罗布泊。俱乐部的微信群里，最后一条消息还是他出发前发的：“兄弟们，这: Howard Zheng never made it out of Lop Nur. In the club's WeChat group, the last message is still the one he sent before setting out: “Brothers, this crossing is on me.” Nobody ever spoke in that group again, and nobody ever disbanded it.
strings.都闭嘴，省点口水: Everybody shut up. Save your spit
strings.重庆人，辞了职的程序员。他拉着一辆捆着六十升水的两轮拉车，从北边的罗布泊镇出发，: A Chongqing man, a programmer who quit his job. He set out from Lop Nur Town, hauling a two-wheeled handcart with sixty liters of water lashed to it, to walk alone to where Yu Chunshun died and kowtow there. On the third night a dust haze blew in; after daybreak he never found his handcart again. His phone held a China Telecom SIM — out here, it sometimes gets one bar more than anyone else's.
strings.重庆话，语速快，爱说“我跟你说嘛”“莫得事”“要讲科学”。: Chongqing dialect, fast talker; fond of saying “I'm telling you”, “Ain't no problem”, “Be scientific about it”.
strings.钥匙一拧，普拉多咳嗽了几声，轰的一下打着了火。沟底的几个人又叫又跳，有人哭了出来: The key turned; the Prado coughed a few times and then roared to life. Down in the gully, the others yelled and jumped, and someone burst into tears.
strings.钥匙在手里，主动权就在手里；可他未必好惹: Hold the keys and you hold the upper hand; but he isn't someone to cross
strings.钱好说，好说。命要紧嘛。: Money's easy, easy. It's your life that matters.
strings.钱我出。我加钱，多带一个行不行？: I'll pay. I'll add money — can you take one more?
strings.防冻液被小心地倒进坑底，离杯子远远的。: The antifreeze was poured carefully into the pit bottom, well away from the cups.
strings.陆子昂压低声音对大家说：苏芮相机里拍着违规穿越、他猛踩油门、郑浩说“报备随便填”: Ryan Lu lowered his voice and told everyone: Ruby Su's camera had footage of the illegal crossing, of himself flooring the gas, of Howard Zheng saying “just write anything on the permit”. If that footage got out, they would all face charges. He wanted Ruby Su to hand over the memory card and snap it in half on the spot.
strings.陆子昂是一个人消失在沙海里的。他爸雇了两架直升机、三支救援队，在雅丹群里找了整整: Ryan Lu vanished into the sea of sand alone. His father hired two helicopters and three rescue teams and searched the yardangs for a solid month, and in the end found only one of his shoes. The Land Cruiser was hauled back to Beijing and parked in the garage, and nobody ever drove it again.
strings.陆子昂是坐着那辆破皮卡先走的人，两万块钱是他转的。转完账，他在钾盐厂的医务室里蒙: Ryan Lu was one of those who rode out first in the beat-up pickup; he was the one who sent the 20,000 yuan. After he sent it, he cried under a blanket all night in the potash plant infirmary. Back in Beijing he joined a volunteer rescue team, and the first thing they trained on was this: in the desert, how to sit with a person and wait.
strings.陆子昂的嘴唇抖了半天，最后一个人钻进了自己的车里。: Ryan Lu's lips trembled for a long moment; then he climbed into his own vehicle alone.
strings.陆子昂的遗体是被他爸雇的直升机接走的。那台陆地巡洋舰一直留在雅丹沟边，后来成了穿: Ryan Lu's body was airlifted out by a helicopter his father hired. The Land Cruiser stayed beside the yardang gully, and later became a spot where people crossing Lop Nur stopped to take pictures. Someone had written a line on the door in marker: “What's the big deal.”
strings.陆子昂的陆地巡洋舰陷进了虚土，他不听劝一直猛踩油门，水箱开了锅，发动机拉了缸。郑: Ryan Lu's Land Cruiser bogged in soft dust; he ignored warnings and gunned it until the radiator boiled and the engine seized. Howard Zheng scouted ahead in the old Prado and rolled it into a yardang gully. The old guide Memet, riding shotgun, was thrown clear: fractured pelvis, gashed head. His black dog Kara bolted from the back seat and never left him; no one could drive him off. The satellite phone was dead; no phone had a bar.
strings.陆子昂花了八万块钱，请人把那台陆地巡洋舰从罗布泊里拖了出来。车拉回北京那天，他爸: Ryan Lu paid 80,000 yuan to have the Land Cruiser towed out of Lop Nur. The day it was hauled back to Beijing, his father walked a circle around it and said nothing. Ryan Lu never touched off-roading again; the truck sat in the garage gathering dust, Lop Nur salt still wedged in the treads.
strings.陆子昂蹲在车边，抱着头哭得喘不上气：“我不想死在这儿……”{actor} 下意识: Ryan Lu crouched by the vehicle, clutching his head, sobbing so hard he couldn't breathe: “I don't want to die out here…” {actor} raised the camera without thinking.
strings.陆子昂随身带的一盒头孢。: A box of cephalosporin Ryan Lu carried with him.
strings.限水不如限汗：配给只决定什么时候渴，能活多久取决于总水量和出汗量。营地的遮阳棚越: Rationing water matters less than rationing sweat: rations only decide when you get thirsty; how long you live depends on total water and sweat. The more intact the camp's sunshade, the less its people sweat by day (fully intact: about 1.6 L less per person per day). Save the heavy work for night and the same water lasts a day or two longer.
strings.除了盐壳和土丘，什么也没有: Nothing but salt crust and dirt mounds
strings.随着一声闷响，普拉多四个轮子砸回了地面，扬起一大片白灰。所有人瘫坐在沟底，好半天: With a dull thud, the Prado's four wheels slammed back to the ground, throwing up a sheet of white dust. Everyone slumped in the gully bottom, and for a long while nobody spoke.
strings.雨只下了二十分钟。所有人跪在塑料布边上，把积水一捧一捧地灌进瓶子里，有人边灌边哭: The rain lasted only twenty minutes. Everyone knelt at the edge of the plastic sheet, scooping the pooled water into bottles one handful at a time; some wept as they filled them.
strings.雨点敲在锅底，叮叮当当地响。: Raindrops rattled on the bottom of the pot, a bright, tinny drumming.
strings.雷太近了，躲进车里: Thunder's too close — get in the vehicle
strings.馕、饼干、牛肉干、几包泡面和化成一摊的巧克力。天太热，谁也吃不下多少。: Naan, biscuits, beef jerky, a few packs of instant noodles and chocolate melted into a puddle. Too hot for anyone to eat much.
strings.驼铃声是从东边传过来的。阿奇克谷地的牧民艾山找一峰走失的小骆驼，找了整整三天——: The camel bells came from the east. Aishan, a herder from Aqqik Valley, had spent three days looking for a lost camel calf — what he found was a group of people nearly dead of thirst. He unloaded two water skins, rode through the night back to his winter camp forty kilometers away, and called the police on the township's BeiDou phone. At noon the next day the rescue convoy drove into the yardangs on his coordinates. Survivors: {survivors}.
strings.骆驼认得回驼群的路，驮着水能走得更远；可营地要分出去两桶水: A camel knows the way back to the herd and can carry water farther than anyone on foot; but the camp would have to give up two barrels of water
strings.黄褐色的沙墙压过来，白天暗得像黄昏，出去几步就看不见车。: A yellow-brown wall of sand bore down on them; day went dark as dusk, and a few steps out you lost sight of the vehicle.
strings.黑烟升得老高，可那个小黑点没有转向。: The black smoke rose high, but that small dark dot never turned.
strings.黑烟滚滚地升了起来。: Black smoke rolled up in a column.
strings.黑色的座椅垫、备胎和石块在白花花的盐壳上摆出了三个十几米长的字母。太阳升高以后，: Black seat cushions, a spare tire and rocks were laid out on the glaring white salt crust to spell three letters more than ten meters long. As the sun rose, everyone's clothes soaked through and dried again, leaving rings of white salt.
strings.（何川蹲在棚子的最里头，用指甲在盐壳上一道一道地划着天数。）: (Chris Ho crouches at the very back of the shelter, scratching the days one by one into the salt crust with his fingernail.)
strings.（卡拉冲着北边的黑暗低低地吼了两声，耳朵竖得笔直。）: (Kara gives two low growls at the darkness to the north, ears bolt upright.)
strings.（卡拉在棚子底下刨了个坑，把自己埋进下面凉一点的沙子里，只露出一个脑袋。）: (Kara digs a hollow under the shelter and buries himself in the cooler sand below, leaving only his head out.)
strings.（卡拉把下巴搁在老买的手背上，谁叫它也不挪窝。）: (Kara rests his chin on Uncle Memet's hand and will not move for anyone.)
strings.（卡拉的爪垫烫破了，走一步就缩一下爪子，回头舔一舔。）: (Kara's paw pads are scorched and split; every step he snatches a paw back and turns to lick it.)
strings.（卡拉趴在车底的阴影里，舌头伸得老长，肚皮一起一伏，像一只破风箱。）: (Kara sprawls in the shade under the vehicle, tongue hanging long, belly rising and falling like a broken bellows.)
strings.（天一黑，卡拉就钻出车底，鼻子贴着盐壳朝东边小跑了一段，又一颠一颠地回来了。）: (As soon as it's dark, Kara slips out from under the vehicle and trots a short way east, nose to the salt crust, then comes limping back.)
strings.（小骆驼伸长脖子，朝东边“嗷——”地叫了一长声，叫得人心里发毛。）: (The camel calf stretches her neck and lets out a long “aaoo—” to the east, a cry that sets the nerves jangling.)
strings.（小骆驼卧在车边，下巴贴着盐壳，一动不动，只有长长的睫毛偶尔眨一下。）: (The camel calf lies by the vehicle, chin against the salt crust, perfectly still; only the long lashes blink now and then.)
strings.（小骆驼舔着车门上凝出来的一点露水，舔了很久。）: (The camel calf licks at the little dew beading on the door, and keeps licking for a long while.)
